questions.question:
Create the namespace `frontend`. In it, create a Deployment `web` with the image `nginx:1.27`, container port `80` and `3` replicas.

All replicas must be available.

verification.description: Namespace frontend and Deployment web (3 x nginx:1.27, port 80)
Deployment web has 3 available replicas

questions.question: The Deployment `api` in the namespace `backend` runs `2` replicas. Scale it to `5` replicas.

verification.description: api has 5 replicas
Deployment api has 5 available replicas

questions.question:
In the namespace `default`, create a Pod `multi` with two containers:

- `web`, image `nginx:1.27`
- `sidecar`, image `busybox:1.36`, command `sleep 3600`

Both containers must be running.

verification.description: multi has the containers web and sidecar
Pod multi has both containers ready

questions.question:
One worker node has the label `disk=ssd`.

In the namespace `default`, create a Pod `ssd-pod` (image `nginx:1.27`) that can **only** be scheduled on a node with that label, using a `nodeSelector`. The Pod must be running.

verification.description: ssd-pod uses nodeSelector disk=ssd
ssd-pod runs on the disk=ssd node

questions.question:
Taint the node `k3d-cluster-agent-1` with the key `env`, value `prod` and effect `NoSchedule`.

Then create a Pod `prod-pod` in the namespace `default` (image `nginx:1.27`) that tolerates this taint and runs on `k3d-cluster-agent-1` (use a `nodeSelector` or `nodeName` to place it there).

verification.description: k3d-cluster-agent-1 has the taint env=prod:NoSchedule
prod-pod tolerates the taint and runs on k3d-cluster-agent-1

questions.question: Expose the Deployment `api` in the namespace `backend` with a `ClusterIP` Service `api-svc` that listens on port `8080` and forwards to the container port `80`. The Service must have endpoints.

verification.description: api-svc: ClusterIP 8080 -> 80, selects app=api
api-svc has ready endpoints

questions.question:
In the namespace `db`, the Deployment `db` (Pods labeled `app=db`) listens on TCP port `6379`.

Create a NetworkPolicy `allow-api-to-db` in `db` so that the `app=db` Pods accept ingress on TCP `6379` **only** from Pods of the same namespace labeled `role=api`. All other ingress to those Pods must be denied.

The Pods `api-client` (`role=api`) and `intruder` (`role=web`) exist for testing, e.g. `kubectl exec -n db api-client -- nc -zv -w 3 db 6379`.

verification.description: allow-api-to-db selects app=db with an Ingress rule from role=api on 6379
api-client reaches db:6379, intruder is blocked

questions.question:
Create a PersistentVolume `pv-data`: capacity `1Gi`, access mode `ReadWriteOnce`, `hostPath` `/mnt/data`, `storageClassName: manual`.

Create a PersistentVolumeClaim `pvc-data` in the namespace `default` requesting `500Mi` (`ReadWriteOnce`, `storageClassName: manual`) so that it binds to `pv-data`.

Then create a Pod `data-pod` in `default` (image `nginx:1.27`) that mounts the claim at `/usr/share/nginx/html`.

verification.description: pv-data: 1Gi, RWO, hostPath /mnt/data, class manual
pvc-data is Bound to pv-data
data-pod mounts pvc-data at /usr/share/nginx/html and runs

questions.question: Create a StorageClass `fast-local` with the provisioner `rancher.io/local-path`, `volumeBindingMode: WaitForFirstConsumer` and `reclaimPolicy: Delete`. It must not become the default StorageClass.

verification.description: fast-local is configured as requested

questions.question:
In the namespace `apps`:

- create the ServiceAccount `deploy-bot`
- create the Role `deploy-manager` that allows `create`, `get`, `list` and `update` on `deployments`
- create the RoleBinding `deploy-bot-binding` that binds the Role to the ServiceAccount

`deploy-bot` must **not** be able to delete Deployments or create Pods.

verification.description: ServiceAccount, Role and RoleBinding exist and are linked
deploy-bot has exactly the requested permissions

questions.question:
The Pods of the Deployment `checkout` in the namespace `shop` are not running.

Find the cause and fix the Deployment in place (do not delete and recreate it). The intended image is `nginx:1.27-alpine`. All replicas must become available.

verification.description: checkout uses nginx:1.27-alpine and was not recreated
Deployment checkout has 2 available replicas

questions.question:
Using the cluster's metrics, find the Pod in the namespace `monitoring` that uses the **most CPU**.

Write only its name to `/tmp/exam/q12/high-cpu.txt` on `cka-q12`. (Metrics can take a minute to appear after the Pods start.)

verification.description: high-cpu.txt names the Pod using the most CPU

questions.question:
In the namespace `shop`, the Service `orders-svc` should send traffic to the Pods of the Deployment `orders`, but it has no endpoints.

Fix the Service so that it selects the `orders` Pods. Do not change the Deployment.

verification.description: orders-svc selects the orders Pods, Deployment unchanged
orders-svc has 2 ready endpoints

questions.question:
Create a DaemonSet `log-agent` in the namespace `kube-system` (image `busybox:1.36`, command `sleep 3600`).

It must run one Pod on **every** node of the cluster, including the control-plane node.

verification.description: log-agent uses busybox:1.36 and tolerates the control-plane taint
A log-agent Pod is ready on every node

questions.question:
In the namespace `www`, the Deployment `www` is exposed by the Service `www` on port `80`.

Create an Ingress `www-ingress` in `www` that sends requests for the host `www.example.com` and path `/` (pathType `Prefix`) to the Service `www` on port `80`, using the IngressClass `nginx`. There is no ingress controller, so only the resource is graded.

verification.description: www-ingress routes www.example.com/ to www:80 with class nginx

questions.question:
The Pod `report` in the namespace `reports` does not start (`CreateContainerConfigError`).

Find the cause in the Pod's events and fix it **without** deleting or changing the Pod: the value it is missing is `info`. The Pod must end up Running.

verification.description: report-config has LOG_LEVEL=info and the Pod was kept
Pod report is Running

questions.question:
Set resource defaults and limits for the namespace `team-a`:

1. LimitRange `defaults`: containers without resources get requests `cpu: 100m`, `memory: 128Mi` and limits `cpu: 200m`, `memory: 256Mi`
2. ResourceQuota `team-quota`: at most `10` Pods, `2` CPUs of requests and `2Gi` of memory requests in total

Verify with `kubectl run test -n team-a --image=nginx:1.27 --dry-run=server -o yaml`.

verification.description: LimitRange defaults applies the requested defaults
ResourceQuota team-quota has the requested limits

questions.question:
The namespace `secure-apps` must only accept Pods that meet the **restricted** Pod Security Standard.

1. Configure Pod Security Admission on `secure-apps` to **enforce** and **warn** the `restricted` level (version `latest`)
2. Run a Pod `compliant` in it (image `busybox:1.36`, command `sleep 3600`) that is accepted by that policy and runs as user `1000`

verification.description: secure-apps enforces and warns restricted
compliant runs as user 1000 under the restricted policy
